label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 231
text:
§ 231



 The intermittent disease deserve a special consideration, as well
          those that recur at certain periods - like the great number of intermittent fevers, and
          the apparently non-febrile affections that recur at intervals like intermittent fevers -
          as also those in which certain morbid states alternate at uncertain intervals with morbid
          states of a different kind.
